decision: Existing callsite boundaries reusable; Model selected-layer/window enable and deferred getter are missing. A thin private hook is feasible, no offline-KV replay required.
scope: CPU source read only. No source patch/compile/GPU/remote scan/Git performed. Prior PARK applies offline faithful replay, not in-situ attribution.

existing_hooks.decoder: decoder.RMS_attention.begin -> decoder.attention.begin/end -> decoder.RMS_ffn.begin -> decoder.FFN.begin/end. Whole layer return currently occurs after original final residual and syncStream.
existing_hooks.attention: Actual5775 cache marks prepare/indexer/projectedKV/cache/output begin/end. AttentionOutput marks quant/projection/TP begin/end. Current resident exactM8 shared path bypasses per-row compute marks; do NOT use old row-marker intervals as a resident decode decomposition.
existing_hooks.MoE: Actual vector8540 source retains router.end,gateup.begin/end,downquant.begin,down.begin/end,shared.begin,shared.end_TP.begin,TP.end_cast.begin; measured gate/down interval includes vector dispatch/launch path, not a pure single kernel.
existing_hooks.marker_provider: 5674/5681 component bridge glm_layer_mark_r5670 records cudaEvent on the SAME r.stream, steady-clock wall and CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID. Thread-local tracing=false by default. Only standalone glm_layer_forward_r5670(...profile) sets it; no existing current Model API arms selectedlayer/window. Component bridge also contains unrelated Context, which must not be used to load another Model.
existing_hooks.stage_TLS: modern_glm_pipeline_last_profile supplies only six stage incoming/layers/outgoing host+stream fields. OwnerProfile8219 reads same owner afterforward, captures selected rounds but cannot select a layer.

measurement_contract.wall: CPU steady-clock interval includes enqueue, host blocking and existing drains; threadCPU measures CPU running time.
measurement_contract.events: Stream elapsed spans include host enqueue idle, queued dependency/CCL waits; not GPUbusy or exclusive kernel compute.
measurement_contract.nonoverlap: Use only adjacent marker intervals for one layer; wholelayer attention+MoE need explicit residual/RMS/other buckets. Never add nested attention/projection/TP intervals to enclosing attention or add host/threadCPU/event timelines together.
measurement_contract.drains: Retain original Decoder/Runtime drains; no new per-interval or per-layer synchronization. Read elapsed events only after the original enclosing CAPI return has drained the stream.

minimum_private_hook_proposal.scope_entry: In the actual TextModel stage-local loop immediately around layers_[i]->forward(r,hidden,positions,requests,...), pass Runtime identity and global begin_+i to a TLS scoped marker sink; existing arithmetic/selection/residual/collective order unchanged.
minimum_private_hook_proposal.selection: Explicit owner-dispatched profile phase arm; selected global layer38 (stage1 first full-indexer + sparse MoE, representative of full-indexer layers only), cohort rows0..7 or8..15, N8, all tokens1. Stable harness rounds63..65 map to actual past/position574..576 for I512 because p=512+round-1; not575..577.
minimum_private_hook_proposal.bounded_storage: Preallocate bounded event/CPU-mark storage at an EMPTY/drained phase boundary; use existing marker names, add wholelayer begin/end scope only. Scope end disables sink but does not synchronize/query/free events. Owner getter after original CAPI drain serializes bounded samples then retires records; reset/exception path clears state after existing failstop drain.
minimum_private_hook_proposal.TU_changes: Actual TextModel TU for enter/leave plus isolated provider/sink TU replacing or extending the existing private marker definition exactly once. No Context/class layout change. Existing decoder/cache/vectorFFN/output marker TUs remain unchanged if declarations remain outside shared layout headers; verify actual -M/MD and sole symbol provider before compilation.
minimum_private_hook_proposal.not_existing_API: There is currently no Model-layer/window arm/getter; this paragraph is a concrete minimal integration proposal, not a claim of ready executable source.
minimum_private_hook_proposal.allowed_first_attribution: Wholelayer, attention, MoE and residual/RMS/other nonoverlapping wall/event spans; bounded FFN projection and CCL spans only where current markers actually bracket them. Hostdispatch threadCPU reported separately. No new local-GEMM kernel-level or exclusive CCL busy claim.
minimum_private_hook_proposal.no_KV_import: Observe actual live Model hidden/cache naturally on original path; do not export/import full KV or create a replay Context.

remaining_before_one_load: Implement/review the thin owner-lifetime scope/arm/getter and actual text object binding; current unmodified Model only has coarse TLS, so no blind GPU load now. Root may authorize necessary in-situ profile load after this small runnable closure.
maximum_reclaimable_ms: UNKNOWN until selected-layer data; 489 ordinary enclosing CAPI is context only.
